title.narrative: Somali NGO Alliance for better living conditions for women and marginalized communities in Somaliland

description.narrative: For the project “Somali NGO Coalition for Better Living Conditions for Women and Marginalized communities in Somaliland,” Welthungerhilfe and four national NGOs (ACRIF, BEYDAN, ERDO,VOSOMWO) have joined forces to form a coalition to improve livelihoods, food security, and access to essential services for women and marginalized communities in Somaliland and to strengthen civil society organizations in Somaliland. The project aims to enable 2993 members of vulnerable population groups to apply innovative methods within the food system and to strengthen civil society actors so that they can contribute to strengthening inclusive food systems and strategic planning through community-based advocacy work.

Strategic objective: The economic independence and food security of women and other marginalized population groups in the regions of Woqooyi Galbeed, Togdheer and Sanaag in Somaliland have improved.Project objective: 1,940 members of marginalized population groups (with a special focus on women) in 5 communities from three regions of Somaliland apply innovative methods for the production and processing of algae as food and feed, implement income-generating activities along rural value chains and civil society actors contribute to strengthening inclusive food systems and strategic planning through community-based advocacy work.

The project combines community-based initiatives to strengthen resilience with evidence- and rights-based advocacy to promote nutrition-relevant strategic planning in key sectors (agriculture, livestock, fisheries), addressing macro, meso, and micro levels. Women, ethnic minorities, and people with disabilities are prioritized.
